meta.note_cap_units: A pump.fun 85-SOL graduation seeds the PumpSwap pool at a fixed 410.8 SOL FDV. At the measured SOL price that is ~$42.5k, NOT the user's $69k: $69k is the same event at SOL~$168. The literal --min-market-cap-usd 69000 is therefore a +62% post-migration momentum filter, not the migration event. Every ticket is reported in three units: SOL FDV (price_sol*1e9), USD at measured SOL, and USD at the $69k-defining SOL.

sample_accounting.selection_rule: systematic sample over decision time within each run and cohort after de-duplicating by mint: take the i-th of n equally spaced rows (deterministic).

shadow_coverage.note: 1 h coverage is ~0-6%: the followed launch pool goes silent at migration/death, so the shadow's 'peak' is truncated at the last print and the median collapses to 1.0.  The local shadow cannot be used for forward-peak evidence.

v8_launch_cohort_graduation.note: DexScreener drops pairs over time, so 'no pair' is missing data, not proof of death; 5.2% is a LOWER-bound-style estimate under the assumption that dropped mints never graduated.

wide_current_state.note: DexScreener cannot reconstruct historical peaks (no OHLCV on the key-less host): it measures the CURRENT state and whether a pump.fun launch pair exists at query time.

forward_study.method: GeckoTerminal /pools/{pool}/ohlcv/minute?aggregate=5&limit=1000&before_timestamp=decision+49h. Entry = last 5-min close at/before the recorded decision timestamp; forward peaks = max 5-min CLOSE (robust; candle HIGH kept as upper bound) divided by entry; nadir = min close over 24 h; survival = any candle in the +24 h +/- 4 h / +48 h +/- 4 h windows. One call per token; paced 15 s.

verdict.headline: The graduated/pumpswap population is real and behaves differently from the launch-pool population, but at SOL~$104 the literal $69k gate is a +62% momentum filter, and the measured 300 s post-migration window structurally loses the hottest migrated pools (49% of v8's pumpswap tickets died on the 300-print tape cap). v9 is worth a PAPER test only as a measurement run with the window/quote-coverage kill switch armed.

limitations: GeckoTerminal key-less quota is IP-global and v8 is running: the GT forward sample is 75 P + 30 C + 6 M tickets, not the 80+80 target; every call was paced at 15 s and the OHLCV fetch logged 1 HTTP 429 (25 s auto-recovery) + 1 timeout across 116 calls (v8 gt_penalised stayed at 1 before/after).
5-min candles only: +5/+15/+60 min prices are +/-5 min buckets; the 300-print tape-cap censoring means the v9 universe sample is of ADOPTED pumpswap pools, not all pumpswap pools.

Pumpswap venue is a weak graduation proxy (55% of v8's pumpswap decisions have mints that are not pump.fun mints at all; only 25% carry a curve_read 'migrated'); the online task (task-2) puts the true 85-SOL-graduation share near 1 in 10 historically.
The local shadow cohort cannot measure 1 h forward peaks (<=6% complete observations; pool silence at migration/death), so all forward numbers here come from GeckoTerminal history.
DexScreener wide current-state is time-decayed (42% of mints still indexed); absence of a pair is missing data, not death.
